comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: Wonderful video. I'm afraid I had a very simplistic impression, that Kaiser Wilhelm II had underwritten everything. The emergency help was wonderful, surely one reason there was only one death. But the confluence of young architects, a willing worker force, civic will to finance rebuilding by debt, and solidarity of these citizens combined to give Ålesund one of the mosr uniquely beautiful cityscapes in the style of Art Nouveau/Jugendstil/Secession anywhere. The statue shown is not that of Rollo. Thank you for explaining the difference between klipfisk and stokfisk. What a pleasure to feast one's eyes on the colourful facades of the buildings.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Thank you for watching so closely, and for such a thoughtful read of the story. The way the town came together is still the part that stays with us. Of everything you listed, which piece surprises you most: the young architects, the shared financing, or the solidarity?
